tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal sras zla 'od gzhon nu bzhugs so// bka' rgyud gser 'phreng bzhugs so//

"$ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma bde bar gshegs pa dwags po rin po che'i rnam thar la/ dang po sku 'khrung pa'i yul ni dmyal/ rigs rnyi ba/ yab rnyi ba lha rje la sras bzhi yod pa'i gsum pa/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bya ba yin pa/ 'jig rten mi chos kyi yon tan skyes nas/ chos gsha' ma gcig bya snyams nas/ dang po dge bshes shwa ba gling pa la rab tu byung*/ mtshan yang dge slong bsod nams rin chen bya bar btags/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dang gnyis la gsan pa mang po mdzad/ dge bshes mang yul ba blo ldan la pha rgyud ma rgyud la sogs pa'i gsang sngags mang po gsan par mdzad/ chos thams cad kyi nang na nyams su blang ba kho na gtso bor bshad nas 'dug pas/ dbu ru phyogs su bka' gdams la byon dge bshes bsnyug rum ba dang*/ rgya lcags ri gong ka ba dang*/ dge bshes bya yul ba dang gsum bsten/ jo bo'i gdams ngag ma lus pa mkhyen par mdzad nas/ da ni bsgrub pa gcig bya dgos snyams nas/ rang gi yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i gser kha bya ba na/ brang khang bde mo gcig brtsigs nas/ pha zhing la yon bdag byas nas bsgrub pa byas/ de nas zhag bcu gsum la mi tshor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po byung*/ chags sdang rab 'bring rnams zhi nas/ gnyid thun chung ngur re las mi 'byung ngo*// rmi lam du yang mdo sde gser 'od nas bshad pa'i/ sa bcu thob pa'i snga ltas kyi rmi lam de tsam rmis/ nga la rmi lam 'di tsam rmi mi thang ba la/ sems rmi yin nam/ 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin nam/ ci yin snyam pa byung gsungs/ lus la shig dang srin bu rnams ye med/ zhag lnga lnga tsam du tshal ma ma zos kyang*/ ltogs pa'i 'dun pa ye med/ lus bde nyams dang ldan pa byung gsungs/ nam sla dpyid gcig gi dus su 'tshams nas byung nas lcags ri'i lho phyogs su skyo ba las song tsa na/ sprang po rgad po gsum shig srag shin gtam byed kyin 'dug pa la/

kho bo'i sems rgyud ni ting nge 'dzin du song*/ phyag gis yi dwags la chu sbyin byed kyin yod tsa na/ sprang po gcig na re/ 'o skol gsum 'dra ba'i bsod nams chung ba 'ong ba/ rtsol ba mi dgos par zan chen po re dang 'o ma phor pa re btung rgyu yod na ci to zer/ gcig des yid smon byed na de 'dra ba la byed dam/ mnga' bdag rtse lde 'dra ba re yin na dga' yod zer/ gcig na re/ mnga' bdag rtse lde la yang 'chi ba yod skyid med/ mi la ras pa 'dra ba'i grub thob lus la gos mi dgos pa/ bza' med na mkha' 'gro mas bdud rtsi 'dren pa/ seng ge la bcibs nas nam mkha' la 'gro yin 'dug pa gcig yin na dga' mod zer/ der bla ma rin po ches de rnams gsan pas lus kyi spu zings kyis song nas/ mig nas mchil ma 'khrugs pa gcig byung*/ sngar gyi de ma yin pa'i dad pas rgyun du slang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gcig sems rgyud la skyes nas byung*/ yun ring rab gcig tu 'gro ma shes/ der brang khang du byon nas dge sbyor gyi gtso bo yan lag bdun pa byed pa yin pas/ byas tsam na 'phro stor yin song*/ da ci red pa yin snyams nas mal du bzhugs nas bsgoms tsam na/ khang pa la sogs pa'i phyi rol yul rnams med par song nas/ stong phyal gyis song nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yid kyi yul du byung ba'am/ sems can thams cad kyi sems shes pa snyam byed pa gcig byung*/ der dgong thun thog nas sprang po de rnams āe snang bltas tsam na/ 'gron khang na nyal nas 'dug /da ci khyed kyi gleng ba'i grub thob de gang na yod pa yin byas pa la/ de na re/ mang yul gung thang bya ba na yod mi la ras pa bya ba yin zer/ de'i bla ma gong ma rnams su yin byas pa la/ de'i bla ma mar pa lo tsa ba bya ba yin zer/ de'i bla ma nā ro pan chen bya ba yin zer/ chos ci gsungs byas pa la/ chos de nā ro'i chos drug bya ba dgyes rdor gyi gdams ngag yin zer ba gcig gsungs/

ngas zhal ma mthong zer/ mi phal cher bla ma de'i drung na 'gro yin 'dug pa la/ bla ma de yon tan ci lta bu yod gsungs pa la/ mi phal cher yis song yang mi rnyed pa la/ rnyed kyang la las mchod rten dkar po gcig tu mthong*/ la las shāka thub tu mthong*/ sprul pa sna tshogs byed nus pa gcig 'dug zer/ gzhi che bar gang na 'dug par snang gsungs pa la/ brin dang snye nam gnyis kyi ri kho na la bzhugs zer/ de na 'gro na khyed kyi rogs byed dam byas pa la/ de nyan de khyed gzhon nu gcig 'dug pa ngas khyed kyi rjes mi slebs/ khye rang song dang la stod nas shes nas 'ong gis/ khong grags pa che ba yin zer/ der zan chen po byas lo ma mang po bcos nas de gsum la byin/ der de nub dkon mchog la mchod pa gcig byas/ gsol ba btabs nas nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ rag dung ring po gcig bus pas skad 'dzam bu'i gling du thos pa rmis/ de yang dbus gtsang gnyis na 'di bas che ba'i rag dung med byas pa rmis/ yang khang rten ba gcig la rnga bo che gcig btags nas 'dug pa la/ skad chen po yang dag gcig byung*/ ri dwags mang po nyan shin 'dug /mi dpag tu med pa mang po yang 'dug /mon mo lta bu bud med gcig na re/ mi tsho la ni rnga brdung ri dwags 'di tsho la ni 'di byin gcig zer nas 'o ma thod phor gang byin ba rmis/ 'dis ri dwags 'di tsho mi khyed byas pa la/ khyed rang gsol dang ri dwags 'di rnams bes ni/ 'gro ba ris drug yang khyed par 'ong bas/ nga ni nyi ma nub phyogs su 'gro ba yin zer nas song ba rmis nas/ da lta snod dang mi ldan pa rnams la rim gyis skyes te rnga la nyan pa'i mi de rnams yin par 'dug /bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams drin che gsungs// ri dwags de rnams ni nga'i ri khrod 'dzin pa'i de rnams yin bar 'dug /bla ma mi la pa'i thabs lam dang phyag rgya chen pos bskyang*/ sngon gyi rmi lam gyi steng kho nar song gsungs/

der zhing bzang po gcig yod pa de btsongs nas/ bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin tsam na/ sne shang khyi ra ba bya ba cig kyis bla ma'i nye gnas byed kyin 'dug /lo ro ras chung ba sgom stag jo gdor/ se ban ston cung*/ me sgom/ rkong sgur/ de kun snang*/ nye gnas na re/ dbus pa ston pa khyod 'ong ba bla mas mkhyen par 'dug /thugs la yang 'dogs par 'dug /ngang thung ma byed par zhag 'ga' sdod dang*/ de tsam na bla ma dam pa dang mjal bar 'dug zer nas pha bong gcig gi 'og tu bzhag /sang nyin phyed tsam na shog zer nas phyin tsam na/ bla ma rdo leb gcig gi kha na bzhugs nas/ 'khor rnams kyis mtha' bskor nas 'dug /gser srang gang 'bul ba byas tsa na/ bla ma'i zhal nas gser dang nga lo mi mthun khyed rang bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen gyis gser mi 'dod/ khyod kyi ming ci yin/ bsod nams rin chen bya ba lags zhus pa la/ bsod nams bsod nams bya ba lan gnyis gsungs nas/ bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las byung*// sems can kun kyi rin po che gsungs// de nas mgur gcig bzhengs nas dbus pa ston pa khyod kyi sna len yin no gsung*/ de nas pha bong 'og der mkhan pa dang za shing dang dri sho kho mo bsdus nas phyed spyil byas nas/ yon bdag rkon 'bar dang 'bar si gnyis la/ gser zho re btsongs nas phye byas nas khrid zhus/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod la dbang bskur gyi bka' yod dam gsungs/ dge bshes mang yul blo ldan la/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang rdzogs par zhus/ dgyes rdor gyi lan gsum/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs gsum/ jo bo klu yi pa'i bka' phag mo rin chen rgyan bsgrubs ma'i byin rlabs/ gzhan yang bla ma mang po la dbang bskur mang du thob byas/ nga la zhag bcu gsum du mi tshor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod byas pa la/ ha ha zer nas gad mo chen po gcig shor nas/ byed ma btsir bas mar khu mi 'ong*/ yungs dkar btsir na mar khu 'ong ba yin/

de 'dra ba la dgos pa med/ nga'i gtum mo srog srol sgoms dang*/ sang de gzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas 'ong kyang bod kyi snying du 'dre zhugs pas/ a ti sha la gsang sngags 'chad du ma bcugs pas mi mang po phung gsungs/ bka' gdams pa las gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag mang po yod byas pa la/ de tsam gsang sngags yin yang man ngag min/ bsgrub thabs rkyang pa re re rdzogs rim snod bcud bsdus pa re re bshad nas 'dug ste/ rtogs spyod kyi ting nge 'dzin bya ba yin/ lam rim gyi bdag med ma bsgom ba don spyi rkyang pa yin/ kha rog par thabs lam bsgom dang gsung gtum mo'i khrid zhus nas bsgoms pas/ bde drod rang 'bar la song nas/ zhag bdun gyi nang par rgyal ba rigs lnga zhal mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ mig btsir na gnyis su mthong ba dang 'dra/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung zin pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsung*/ yon tan min zer yang brod pa skyes nas drag tu bsgoms pas/ zla ba gsum lon pa dang tho rangs kha stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'khor lo 'khor ba ltar 'khor shing 'dug pas/ stong skyug byas byas nas 'gyel brgyal nas yun ring gcig tu 'dug bla ma la zhus pa la ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung 'du tir tshud pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsung*/ yang nyi ma lnga dro gcig la mdun gyi nam mkha' la thugs rje chen po tham pa nam par 'dug pa la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re de rnams kyi thog tu yod pa gcig mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pa la/ spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lo thig le phebs pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms dang gsungs/ yang dgong mo gcig dang srod gcig kyi bar la/ dmyal ba thig nag mthong nas des rkyen byas nas/ snying kar 'tshangs nas bzhin du song nas snying rlung drag po gcig byung nas/ bla ma la zhus pa la/ sgom thag thung nas rtsa bcings pa yin/

sgom thag cung ring ba gyis/ gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung zin pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ yang nyin gcig tsam na 'dod lha ris drug gi lha rnams gsal bar mthong*/ gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og ma 'og ma la bdud rtsi yi char 'bab kyin 'dug /lha rnams ngoms nas tshim kyin 'dug pa la/ bdag gi a ma skoms drir shi shing 'dug pa gcig mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pa la/ bdud rtsi 'bab pa de mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ro rkyang gnyis kyi thig le 'phel ba yin/ a ma skom pa 'du ti'i mar sna kha ma bye ba yin pas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di tso gyis dang gsungs nas/ 'khrul 'khor btsan thabs spyi de gnangs nas zla ba gcig bsgoms nas/ lus 'phar 'dar sprugs rgos/ rgyun chad med par rang dbang med par kus 'debs pa byung nas/ 'dre yin nam snyam pa byung nas/ bla ma la zhus pa la/ snying ka chos kyi 'khor lor thig les gang ba yin/ 'khrul 'khor 'phro ma gcad par bsgoms/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsung*/ de nas kha zas che mi dgos/ nyi ma nyin gcig tsam na/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la nyi zla chen po gnyis gzas zin nas 'dug /gza' de rta rnga 'phra mo gnyis su 'dug /bla ma la zhus pa la/ 'du tir ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung chud pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ pho rgod rab tu 'dug /da ni da ni lan gsum tsam gsungs/ de nas drag tu bsgoms pas zla ba gcig na/ dgyes rdor dmar po'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ bla mas da ni zer bas yi dam lha zhal mthong snyams nas/ yang zhus pa la/ lte bar ma las thob pa'i rakta 'phel ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas nyin gcig tsam na/ bde mchog klu yi pa'i keng rus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig mthong nas/ bla ma la zhus pa la/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor thig les gang ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/

de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas zhag bcu bzhi lon tsam/ mtshan thog thag gcig la bdag gi lus 'di nam mkha'i khams tsam gcig red nas 'dug /spyi bo gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad du/ 'gro ba ris drug gi sems can rnams 'dug pa la/ phal cher 'o ma 'ba' zhig 'thung shin 'dug /rdung ting gcig gi sgra gang nas 'ong cha med par dus rgyun du 'ong shin 'dug /nam langs nas bsgom thag bkrol tsam na/ ye med nas thal/ bla ma la zhus pa la/ lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i nang du las kyi rlung gis khrid pa yin te/ rlung de ye shes kyi rlung du bsgyur 'tshal bar gda' gsungs/ mchog gi gtum mo gnang nas bsgoms pas/ nyin gcig tsam na gung thang ba'i lung pa thams cad dud pas gang nas 'dug /phyi dro tsam na mun nag du red nas 'dug /der lam ma rnyed long ba 'gro 'gro byas nas bla ma'i drung du phyin/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ci yang mi sto/ der sdod la sgom dang gsungs nas/ steng gi gegs sel de gsungs pas/ nam langs pa bzhin du song ngo*// yang nub gcig lus kyi keng rus la sha ye mi 'dugs rtsa mang po 'go sbrel nas 'dug pa mthong*/ bla ma la zhus tsam na/ rlung rtsub thal ba yin 'jam pa gyis gsungs/ de nas zla ba gcig lon tsam na dang po sman lha mched bdun mthong*/ nyin gcig la rlung gi 'gro yongs gcog pas rlung klod tsam na yal nas thal/ phyi dro rlung bzungs tsam na longs sku'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnams mthong pas/ de la ma yengs bar du rlung btangs tsam na/ nub mo srod du red nas 'dug /bla ma'i ting 'dzin la gnod snyams nas ma zhus/ maṇḍal 'ba' zhig 'bul nas gsol ba btabs/ tho rangs rlung bzungs tsam na sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo shāka thub yis byas pa mthong*/ nang par bla ma la zhu song tsam na/ phyag byas te kun bzlo ma khom bar/ da ni da ni yi dam lha zhal mthong ste/ longs sku dang sprul sku gnyis su mthong*/

chos sku da gzod mjal bar gda'i/ da dbus su song la sgoms shig /sngar gyi 'phrang de tsho ngas bsal ba yin/ da mngon par shes pa'i 'phrang 'ong*/ mngon shes 'byung tsam na lha'i bu'i bdud 'jug pa yin pas/ shin tu gsang ba gal che/ spyir yang yon tan thams cad gsang ba gal che/ spyir dbang po rnon po rgyu'i stobs can la bdud kyis mi tshugs pa yin te khyod dbang po rnon por 'dug ste/ gsang sngags gsang na 'grub pas gsongs la bsgrub pa gyis shig /sems can la yang phan par 'dug pas 'tshogs pa skyongs shig gsungs/ 'tshogs pa bskyang ba'i dus nam lags zhus pa la/ sems gyi ngo bo mthong nas de brtan pa dang skyongs/ rlung lags sor du drongs par 'dug mi 'dug ltos/ de drongs pa dang rlung gi 'phrang la thar ba yin gsungs/ de nub rdo leb gcig gi steng du thal ba blugs pa la sor mo gtad cing rlung bcun tsam na/ nam phyed tsam na thal ba bun bun byed/ nang par bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin tsam na/ rtsa rlung la dbang thob bya ba min ste/ rtsa rlung las su rung ba yin/ da nga dang 'grogs mi dgos par song cig /sprul ba dang bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ mchog thun mong gnyis ka'i dngos grub thob nas 'ong gis/ khyed kyi ming yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags pa bya ba yin no// de nas dbang byin rlabs kyi bka' gnang*/ chos thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas da yul du song la bsgoms/ dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung*/ de'i grib 'phog pa yin/ de gang yin na snang ba dgrar langs pa'i mi/ chos dang gang zag thams cad la ngan smras phyir 'thags pa'i mi rigs yod de/ de'i nang na zhe sdang me 'bar ba yod pa yin/ dper na sems can sbrul gshog pa yang med/ sbrul bas nyams chung ba yang med/ kho mthong ba dang mi thams cad sdang ba dang bred pa de/ de'i nang na zhe sdang chen po yod pa yin/

nang na zhe sdang yod na phyi rol yi sdang ba dgrar lta ba yin/ yang gang zag kha gcig na re/ rdo bug pa can dang shing nyag ga can tshags byed pa yod/ rgas na nad brgyags dur brgyags dgos de min na chos 'chor/ de min na gzhon na tshogs bsogs pa la yang nor dgos zer/ tha mar log 'tsho bun bskyed 'ba' zhig byed pa yod/ de'i nang na 'dod chags chu bzhin khol ba yod pa yin/ gang zag kha gcig yang dag pa'i don sgom pa'i dus da lta ma yin/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ba ni mi srid/ tshogs ma bsags sgrib pa ma sbyangs snying rje ma bsgoms pas nyan thos su gol/ thabs khyad du bsad pas chad lta ba yin zer ba yod/ de'i nang na gti mug gis bcings pa yod pa yin/ de 'dra ba'i mi dang gtam byed du yang mi rung*/ gtam byas na dang po khyed kyi ston pa su yin chos gang yin bla bo de la brten nas kho zhe sdang skye ba yin/ thos nas blo chung de'i yod ni spongs byed de/ spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ bya ba de'i dus su 'byung bas/ bdag la brten gzhan gyis sdig sogs pas/ dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung*/ dam tshig chos kyi nang nas kyang*/ nyan thos nang nas zhag bdun 'das// zhes bya ba'i don yang de 'dra ba la zer ba yin/ spyi yang ri dwags sman ma'am/ bya bzhin du zon bags che bar byas/ zhi ba dul ba tse rag chung ba thams cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ rtogs pa shin tu chung bar bya/ ri la 'tshams dang smra bcad dang 'dag char gsum yis dus 'da' bar bya/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang*/ bla ma dam pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon mi spang ba la bslabs/ bsags sbyang gnyis po rang sar dag kyang*/ tshogs chung ngu chung ngu nas bsags/ las rgyu 'bras nam mkha' ltar go yang*/ sdig pa chung ngu chung ngu la 'dzems/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob med pa'i nyam myongs yod kyang*/

thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du go yang*/ chos dang gang zag la bskur pa mi btab gsung ngo*// de nas dbus su byon nas/ se ba lung gi dgon par bka' gdams pa yi gseb tu bzhugs nas bsgoms pas/ lus ngag gi bya ba mang po dang kha thon mang po byas/ khong gi kha thon gyi ram bu 'gyogs 'gyogs nas/ ting nge 'dzin shor/ de ma byas na sdig sogs par 'dug pas/ 'ol ka na phar bud nas song bas bon po gcig gis yon bdag byas nas dge lung du bsgoms pas/ bde drod rang 'bar/ rtsa rlung gi rtogs pa thams cad sor chud par byung*/ der lo gsum bsgoms pas der gzod sems kyi ngo bo shes/ bla mas gsungs pa de 'di yin yang snyam pa byung*/ chos thams cad phyi shun dang sbun bu lta bur song*/ skyes bus gser gyi sna snyed pa'am/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa'am/ 'gron po rang khyim du rtol ba bzhin du bya/ sems 'di dang bral/ ngas skye ba cig gis thogs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa yin yang snyams ba dang*/ sgom rta thog tu skyol/ bsgom bdag po'i lag tu gtad/ bla ma rin po che med pa ang snyam pa byung*/ gdams ngag rin po che ngo mtshar che ang snyam ba byung*/ dus de nas da lta'i bar la nyams la 'phel 'gribs med/ rtogs pa mthon dman med/ spangs blangs med/ the tshom med/ de nas nyin gcig srub bya ba la/ bsgom zhing yod tsam na/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ bu gcig yod pa'i ske bcad nas skye rgyud bcad do byas nas ro rbab tu bsgril nas bzhags pa rmis/ de nas de phyin chad rmi lam ye rmis ma myong*/ gnyid 'thug por 'ong bar 'dug ste 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar 'dug /nga la ni bsgom rgyud la skye bar byed pa la dka' blas chen po dgos par byung*/ da lta khyed rnams la ni tsheg med par skye zhing 'dug ste/ gdams ngag thabs lam 'di zab pa'i steng du/

bka' brgyud 'di la byin rlabs phebs chen po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gcig yod/ bsgoms nas dka' ba spyad nus na lam sna zin pa mang po 'ong bar 'dug /bogs thon bar chad sel nyams myongs skye bar byed pa la/ lam zab mo bla ma'i lam gyis dbang bskur ste/ thon nas de kha yar bsgoms pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang gtum mo 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas chog par 'dug gsungs/ der bla ma rin po ches 'ol kar lo bdun bsgrub pa nyams su blangs/ mi mang po 'dus pas 'dug tu ma ster ste/ zang zing chen po byung ba'i yo byad rnams 'ol ka ba rnams la 'gos nas byin/ dbyar 'od de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bsgom du bzhud tsam na/ nang par tho rangs kha gcig dngos kyi gdul bya yal bar dor/ byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba yin zer ba'i sgra byung*/ dgun kha ba 'bab par 'dugs/ de nas 'gro dgos snyams nas/ btsad po'i gzugs su 'dug pa dar yi thod chen po bcings pa/ 'gul du g.yu chen po gcig btags pa gcig na re/ 'di rang du bzhugs na yon bdag ni ngas byed nyan te/ da mi bzhugs na nga'i bu dwags la sgam po'i can du bzhugs cig /khos khyod kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par byed kyis zer/ bdag mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags yin bas/ sems can la gnod pa bskyal snyams med mod kyang*/ mang po la bab kyi gnod par 'dug /sdig bshags gcig kyang zhu skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gcig kyang zhu zer/ der stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags thabs dang*/ byams snying rje blos sbyangs thabs dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnang nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom gdabs dgos snyam nas/ nam mkha' la yal ba bzhin du thal/ de nas dwags la sgam por byon/ lo bcu gnyis su 'dag char bya dgos snyams nas/ zangs zlum du 'dag char gyi khang pa gcig byas/ dang po chu'i bcud len bya dgos snyam tsam na/ bud med lus thal bas byugs pa/ lag na rma bya'i sgro bzung ba gcig na re/

bcu gnyis bdag char byed pa bas/ bcu gnyis bstan pa spel na dga' zer/ de nas zhag 'ga' lon tsam na/ dge bshes rgyal ba khyung tshang ba yong*/ de nas dge bshes gnyags nag po bang phyin/ de nas gnyags dmar po ba phyin/ der dpon g.yog drug bcu rtsa gnyis tsam du red/ de tsho khrid tshar bar byas la 'tshams dam po bya dgos snyam tsam na/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams dus gcig la 'dus/ yun ring ma thog par nyams rtogs khyad pa bar can du 'phags/ rtsa rlung rten 'brel dpag tu med pa yod pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa drug ka shar ba'i gang zag dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'khor de rnams yang ma brtag pa'i dngos po brgyad mi 'chang ba/ tsog pu'i rnal 'byor la brtson ba/ thams cad sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa/ gsang spyod dang 'tshams 'ba' zhig la gnas pa byung*/ yang sku'i bkod pa dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ dwags po lha sa ba na re/ dgun zla ra ba'i gnyis gsum gyi nyin par/ dwags po lha sar byon/ bcu bzhi yi nyin par sta gon byas/ bco lnga la me tog gtor/ bcu drug la gtang rag mchod pa byas ste/ chos ston dang 'bul ba rgya chen po byas zer nas/ bcu bdun gyi nyin par/ gsung rab mang po dang*/ nas mang po dang*/ sha mar mang po dang*/ snam bu mang po dang*/ 'bul ba rnams sgam por bskyal nas de rnams kyi bsngo ba mdzad do// gral de ma zhig par yon bdag dge 'bum 'khor bcas phyin/ bla ma rin po che pas thugs la btags pas/ bcu bzhi'i nyin par sta gon byas/ bco lnga la me tog gtor/ bcu drug gi nyin par gtang rag gi mchod pa chen po byas nas/ dpon g.yog bdun nam mkha' la bzhud do// ngo mtshar che zer nas sha mar mang po 'bul ba bskyal/ yon bdag de'i bsngo ba mdzad do// gzhi na yod pa'i gra pa rnams 'tshams la gnas pa/ bla ma gnyis gsum la 'tshams la 'byung nas/

bcu bzhi yi nyin mtshan la gtsang pa rnams kyi khrid mdzad/ bco lnga'i nyin mtshan la khams pa rnams kyi khrid mdzad/ bcu drug gi nyin mtshan la dbu pa rnams kyi khrid mdzad do// bla ma rin po che 'di gang su yang ma bzhud ces zer ro// nye gnas gsal byang sho sgom/ byang ye dang*/ sgom pa legs mdzes dang gsum na re/ bla ma rin po che ni zla ba gsum la chos kyang ma bshad/ gar yang ma bzhud/ gsol zas kyang ma gsol/ smra bcad mdzad/ skyo bsrang la yang ma bzhud/ gzims mal kho na la bzhugs shing 'dug zer/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ bsgom pa legs mdzes kyis/ sngon kyi nyan thos rnams kyis ni/ zad par dang zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin mang po bsgrub par 'dug /da lta mi 'grub par 'dug pa de ci lags zhus pas/ sems sbyongs mi byed pa yin/ bsgrub na mi 'grub pa'i don min gsungs/ nang par zho'i nang du bu ram blugs nas 'dren du song tsam na/ bla ma'i gzims mal na/ me chen po gcig 'bar zhing*/ thog la reg reg 'dug /bred nas gsal sbyangs can du brgyugs nas phyin/ gnyis po 'grogs nas yar phyin tsam na/ zad par me'i snang ba bstan par 'dug /bla ma mal na bzhugs na 'dug /yang dus gcig tshe mar me 'ga' byas nas/ mchod khang du bskyal song tsam na/ mchod khang chus mer kyi gang nas 'dug /de ci yin snyams nas se skor 'ga' byas tsam na/ bla ma'i zhal nas da yar shog gsungs nas/ zad par chu'i ting nge 'dzin bstan no// yang dro gcig gi tshe dro ting la steng khang na bzhugs pa'i dus na/ yon bdag dad rgyal sgo nas byung nas rin po che la ja 'di 'bul 'dod zer/ zhur song ba la gser gyi mchod rten 'od lhang lhang 'dug /zad par sa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan no// yon bdag la bstan dgos snyams nas khrid nas song tsam na/ bla ma nyid bzhugs nas 'dug /yang dus gcig gi tshe na 'dre bzhi rtsas bcad kyi gdams ngag de zhu snyam nas/ gtor ma cha gcig khyer nas song tsam na/

nang na ma bzhugs par snang*/ sgor bltas tsam na/ steng na yang mi bzhugs par snang*/ de tsam na khyod ci 'dod mar shog gsungs/ mal na bzhugs nas snang*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe/ dge bshes khams pa na re/ slob dpon bsgom ba la/ bla ma rin po che la grib ma med pa khyod kyi rtogs sams/ nub mo mar me la bltas pa la grib ma mi 'dug /nyin nyi ma la yang grib ma mi 'dug ste/ dus thams cad du grib ma mi 'dug /yang dus gcig gi tshe/ bsgom pa blo brten gyis shog gu 'bum tshar 'bul ba byas/ bla ma la zhus nas/ kho rang spyan sngar btangs tsam na/ khyed kyi phyag stong spyan stong ba'i 'der so 'di nam byas/ bzo bo su yin re legs/ bla ma gar bzhud dang nga dang sprod zer ro// legs mdzes kyis khrid nas song tsam na/ 'der so med nas bla ma bzhugs nas snang*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ ro skam ba'i dge 'dun rnams kyi stong 'bul gcig 'ongs nas/ shing spang su khri brtsigs mang skol gcig byas/ sgo ba shor gzhon rin po che spyan 'dren du song tsam na/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed ber thul khur ba sngon du song*/ nye gnas kun mi 'dug khyim was glogs pa yin/ ngas sgo byas la 'ong gsungs/ kho sngon la ma song nas 'phrang ka na bsdad/ byon du ri tsam na med/ mar la bltas tsam na/ shing spang na bzhugs nas snang*/ de ci tsug yin nam snyam nas song tsam nas/ ban skye stong tsam gyis phyag rten tshar nas/ nye gnas la rgol du byung*/ khyod kyis rin po che 'khyag du bcugs zer/ thang ba brkyangs pa dang bzhugs nas 'dug go /yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ bla ma sgom pas byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po bas/ stong gsum rdul phra rabs gcig tu bcugs pas rdul cher ma song*/ stong gsum chung du ma song zer ste/ mtshar zhus pas/ shes bya'i chos yin/ kun rdzobs kyi snang ba la ci yang nyan/ mi yi rno mig yungs 'bru tsam yi nang du/ ngo mtho gang ba'i gzugs brnyan chud/

me long sor bzhi ba'i nang du/ rta dang glang po che'i gzugs brnyan chud/ chu phor gang gi nang du/ zla ba'i da la nam mkha' yong chud/ nga la tshur ltos dang gsungs/ bla ma byang chub chen po'i sku sgam po'i ring bsil che ba gcig tu gyur nas 'dug pa la/ gzims mal na mi lnga las ma shong ba de ka'i nang du chud nas 'dug /yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ nyi ma gzas zin cing yang ba mang skol byas/ dge 'dun stong tsam 'tshogs nas 'dug pa'i sa der/ rin po che yang dgon gyi thad nam mkha' na byon nas/ rdo rje ra ba'i rtsa na phar bzhud tshur bzhud byed cing bum chu gtor zhing 'dug pa/ mi stong tsam yis mthong*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ 'gar sgom dkar pos lha bcu gsum ma'i lung de zhu byas pas/ de byas pas chog gsungs nas/ bcu gsum ma'i 'phreng sngags de zhal nas nar kyi gsungs nas/ 'od zer kha dog dmar por byung nas/ 'gar sgom yi thugs kar thim/ 'gar sgom phyag 'tshal nas/ mos gus byas tsam na/ bla ma bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gyur 'dug /yang dus gcig tshe na skyo sgom yi ma shi nas dge rtsa rigs lnga tshar gcig bzhengs nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ 'di la rab gnas gcig zhu dgos/ nga ma'i ro srag pa la rings byas pas/ 'o de bya gsungs nas/ spos ring gcig sregs la maṇḍal phul dang gsungs/ bla ma byang chub chen po'i skur gyur nas 'dug /dbu'i gtsug tor nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'ja' tshon lta bu byung ba dang*/ thang sku la thug pas dril shing kun khral khral tir tir 'dug /nam mkha' la gdugs dang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ rol mo'i sgra mang po dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa'i snang ba gcig kyang skyo sgom la byung*/ spyan har kyi phyes nas rab gnas myur mor byed na de tsug byed pa yin da rgyug gsung*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ rgyal ba khyung tshang can gyi bsam pa la/ bla ma rin po ches kyang btsun chung 'di kun la/

thos pa bag re byed mi bcug par/ sgom zhing tshe la bcug pas yon tan ci skye ang snyam pa la/ de'i nub mo rmi lam nas/ sgam po'i ri thams cad brag phug gis gang nas 'dug /de'i nang na rin po che'i mchod rten gyi gang nas 'dug /phal cher bzo shin tu legs par tshar ba 'od zer nam mkha' la 'phro ba kho na 'dug /la la ni bzo shin tu phyed tsam tshar nas 'dug /la la ni gzugs dod pa tsam/ kar chab kyis gsol zhing mi mang pos phyag 'tshal zhing*/ 'di kun thams cad 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mchod gnas yin zer ba rmis/ der nang par bla ma la zhus bas tsam na/ phyag byas nas zhur ma khom bar bla ma'i zhal nas/ spyir mtshan nyid pa khyed tsho nga la sdang*/ sgos su khyod kyis nga la brnyas te/ nga'i btsun chung 'di tsho khyod kyi rmi lam na rmis pa bzhin du yod pa yin/ phrang drug 'di tsho kun yang 'jig rten na lha dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas su yod pa yin/ kho bo la ni cher reg pa cher 'tshing chung du reg pa chung du 'tshing pa yin/ kho bos bstan pa bsnubs zer ba yod de/ bstan pa'i bdag po su yin/ bstan pa la su phan/ sems can yi don sus byas/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams na 'dir bstan pa sus srung*/ mi kun da te lo 'ga' na gsal te 'ong gsungs/ yang ra rdzi sgom skyes kyis/ rin po che'i mtshan thos pa dang sgom byung ba dang*/ nam sa phan legs pa'i mi mang pos zhal mthong bas sgom byung ba dpag tu med do// yang brom dmar su bya ba dang po dge slong byas/ rin po che la gtum mo'i khrid rdzogs par zhus/ las kyi dbang gis khyim byas/ bu smad mang po dang phag mang po gsos/ nyin par chang dang sgog pa la zas byas/ gnyid nam sad pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang gtum mo sgom pa cig yod pa de/ kho 'chi kar nad drag pos zin/ spun zla kun na re khyod 'chi bar 'dug pa la/ sdig pa khyod pas che ba med pas sdom pa shor

/dam tshig nyams rin po che'i bka' bcag /da dge bshes nam pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa bos la 'bul ba gyis skyabs 'gro zhu dgos byas pa la/ nad pa na re rung zer/ dge bshes bos nas skyabs 'gro byas pa la/ nga'i rin po che'i skyabs 'gro dang mi mthun bar snang zer/ rin po ches ci skad gsungs byas pa la/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems kyi chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs nas/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin/ dus thams cad du spyod lam rnams bzhir nyams myongs dran shes kyi thag pas bzungs nas mnyam rjes med na/ chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ ci byed thams cad theg pa chen po'i lam du song na/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin/ khyod kyis de la tshigs gi skyabs 'gror 'dug zer/ dge bshes na re/ te sprug dmyal bar 'gro bar 'dug /nga'i chos la log lta skyes zer nas song*/ der 'brom dmar spu ba shi nas ro bsrags pas/ ring srel kha dog sna lnga phul la 'jal ba dang*/ dud pa 'ja'i dkyil 'khor du rid sgal tshigs gcig la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku byon no// de la sogs pa'i sdig po che mang po/ rin po che dang mjal tsam yis ltas bzang po dang bcas pa zad pa med do// yang dus gcig gi tshe/ slob dpon sgom pas ro gcig gi rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes pa'i dus su/ lus sems snang ba gsum cig tu 'dres bgyi ba lags/ de'i don ci tsug yin de'i don zhus pa la/ mdun na ka ba gcig yod pa la phyag yug gis mdzad nas/ nam mkha' la dbyug pa g.yugs pa bzhin du thogs pa med par phyal phyal 'dug /de gsum 'gre lugs de tsug 'gre ba yin gsungs so// yang dus gcig gi tshe/ grab kyi tsang po la bzhud tsam na/ chu'i stengs na bding ba ting nas/ phyag g.yon pas 'phreng ba bgrang*/ g.yas pas yi dwags la chu sbyin byed kyin bzhugs pa dang*/ yang bre gu ri bo che bzhugs pa'i dus na/ badzad po lta sgom gyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/

me tog ni rten rnams la rang 'byar du song ba dang*/ me tog snod lhung bzed nam mkha' la bzhag pa dang*/ nyi ma'i zer la chos gos bkal ba dang*/ lha bsgom la sogs pa mi brgya tsam yis/ thugs rje chen po kha sar pa ni mthong ba'i mthun snang gcig byung ngo*// yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ dben phug na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nye gnas legs mdzes la/ nga la zhag bdun du gtam ma byed zer nas/ rtsig pa la thogs pa med par phar bzhud tshur bzhud mang po mdzad/ yang keng rus kyi mi chen po g.yas na gri gug /g.yon na thod pa/ kha ṭām̐ kha gcig 'phrag la bkal nas stag la zhon nas/ ldo bhi he ru ka yis stag la zhon// rigs ngan bu mo 'phongs la bskyon// dur khrod gnas ni khyab par rgyug /nga de yin zer ba ni yin ste// zer zhing nam mkha' la bzhugs te// yang chos gos smad gsum mnabs shing bzhengs te/ zhabs kyi ting pa gnyis sprad nas/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi phyag rgya mdzad nas/ zhag gsum du bzhugs pa la/ nub dang po la bdun du snang*/ gnyis pa la bcu bzhir snang*/ gsum pa la kham chung de tham se nam se gtam ba bzhin du snang*/ skabs la sku ye med par gyur to// gzhan yang gcig pur bzhugs pa'i dus na/ srog rtsol lan gnyis su bgos pas chog pa dang*/ nyams rtogs 'bul ba dang*/ gegs sel ba dang*/ gdams ngag zhu ba la/ gtor ma bshams/ maṇḍal 'bul/ 'khrul 'khor bcas nas bsdad pa tsam yis/ dri mi dgos par bsdad pa tsam yis rang gi sems la ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin du gsungs ste/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon par shes pa mnga' ste/ de dag gi shes lugs rnam bris na zad pa med do/ gzhan yang drang srong chen po de la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang*/ sems can la mi rtag pa bstan pa'i ched du/ bya lo yi skar ma rgyal gyi zla ba drug pa'i rkyang zla'i bco lnga'i nyin par/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ steng gi nam mkha' 'ja'i gdugs mang po dang*/

'ja' ltag bsnol mang po dang*/ rol mo'i sgra mang po dang*/ spos kyi ngad zhim po mang po byung ngo*// bco brgyad kyi nyin par gdung sbyangs pa la/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'od mang po dang*/ rol mo'i sgra mang po che 'bring chung gsum dang*/ dud pa la 'ja'i dkyil 'khor kha dog sna lngar gyur to// dwags po rnams bzhi'i mi rnams 'dus pa la/ me tog sngon po'i char bab pa'i mthun snang gcig kyang byung*/ thugs dang ljags ma tshig par byon pa dang*/ ring srel dpag tu med par byon pa dang*/ der 'du zhing 'tshogs pa'i mi thams cad zhag gsum gyi bar du/ bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang*/ gnyid kyis gdung ba la sogs med ste/ mos gus chen pos sems rgyud la ting nge 'dzin du gyur bar byung ngo*// bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rin po che de yang*/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don grub par byed pa'i skyes bu chen po yin/ de yang dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang*/ mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ lung bstan ste/ sngon kyi dus na yang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar/ mtshan me tog zla mdzes zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gyur to// shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar mtshan byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu bya bar gyur to// da lta'i dus na yang 'tsho byed zhes bya bar gyur to// 'khor rab tu byung ba lnga brgya las mi nyung ba thams cad kyang*/ ting nge 'dzin 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes bya ba lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen por gyur to// grub thob chen po rtsod pa dang bral ba de la/ sras grub thob mang du byung yang*/ yongs su grags pa'i bu chen bzhi la sogs pa byung ba ni/ bla ma sho brom 'phags pa/ gser kong ye shes snying po/ bla ma re mya chos 'byung*/ bram ze ye shes snying po dang bzhi/ brgyud pa 'dzin ba'i sras bzhi ni/ bla ma dwags po sgom tshul/ chos rje phag mo grub pa/ rin po che dbu se/

bla ma 'ba' brom ba dang bzhi/ de la yang nye ba'i sras bzhi ni/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ jo sras la lags/ kye po ye rdor/ 'gar sgom dkar po dang bzhi/ zhabs tog mdzad pa'i nye gnas zhi ni/ jo gnyan/ legs mdzes/ byang ye/ gsal byang dang bzhi'o/ grub thob chen por gyur pa'i/ bla ma dwags po lha rje rin po ches/ 'ba' brom pa la gsungs so// zhus so// rdzogs so// bdag gis 'di bris bsod nams kyis// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /dwags po rin chen rnam thar 'di// dag pa'i snang bas mthong thos rnams// dag pa bde chen zhing khams su// dwags po nyid dang mjal bar shog// /
